finite_endpoint_diagnostic.scope: Complete finite-diagram classification through rank21 only. An allowed finite endpoint type is not a realized Lorentzian/arithmetic edge. The original vertex type is always a finite reextension, so these finite checks alone exclude none of the listed vertices.

hub_source_orbit_diagnostic.proposed_rule: Replace v_destination/(k*c) by v_source_orbit,destination/(k*c). Summing all c hub components contributes m_source_orbit/k times the new bonus per destination root, where k is hub rank and m_source_orbit its root multiplicity. Thus existing spectator counts and additive forest optimization suffice.
hub_source_orbit_diagnostic.scope: Exact census of the 1979 complete-model face rows, not an optimization or a complete global face-coverage theorem. For 44 A4 destination orbits only one of two size-two source orbits occurs in these rows; setting the absent source bonus to zero halves the corresponding vertex contribution while preserving these input payments.
